en-US.description:
Look up Pali words on any web page right in Safari, and search the Pali Canon on Dhamma.Gift.

Select a Pali (or English) word, open the context menu and choose Dhamma.gift: the entry from Dict.Dhamma.Gift opens in a popup or a new window. Dict.Dhamma.Gift shows data from open Pali dictionaries (Digital Pali Dictionary and others, with attribution; not affiliated with their authors).

Features:
- Look up a selected word from the context menu or by double-click
- Display modes: popup, compact or new window
- Dictionary language: English or Russian
- Search the Pali Canon on Dhamma.Gift for the selected text
- "Explain grammar (DharmaMitra)" opens the third-party site dharmamitra.org with the selected text
- Optional hand-off to GoldenDict-NG, DictTango or MDict

Privacy: no account, no data collection, no ads, no tracking.

For students of Pali and anyone reading the suttas online.
